claim: In the matching retail DLL, Audience.CalcCheerLevel (0x060047E0) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 477-byte body. It first loads MatchMain.GetInst().matchTime.sec; only when raw (sec + 1) % 20 equals zero does it refresh CheerLevel_HP. That refresh scans raw player indices 0..7 using PlayerMan.GetPlObj, skips a player when the object conversion is false, isSleep is nonzero, or hasRight is zero, and otherwise accumulates Float32 (HP * 2.0f + SP) / 3.0f. After the scan it calls MatchMisc.GetHealth(total), uses that result to index static CheerHpTbl, and stores the selected Int32 into CheerLevel_HP. Every invocation then stores CheerLevel_Total = CheerLevel_Base + CheerLevel_HP. A second raw 0..7 scan skips null or sleeping players and counts entries whose raw Zone equals 1, 3, 8, or 9; once the count reaches two, it increments CheerLevel_Total by raw one and leaves that scan. A third raw 0..7 scan skips null or sleeping players, and on the first entry with isSallying nonzero increments CheerLevel_Total by raw one and leaves that scan. Finally it clamps CheerLevel_Total to raw -4..4 and returns. FACT-0079 pins the direct TensionDown call at IL+0x0024.
